events.title: Zone Stalkers Demo 1.1.4: New Main Menu, Campfires, Raid Tip, Level Cleanup
events.summary: Stalkers, Demo 1.1.4 is live. The game has a fresh new title screen and main menu, outpost and tunnel campfires now stay lit, resting at a fire actually restores Energy, the raid portal has a sign, and the Kolkhoz has been cleaned up. Multiplayer is still Experimental. TITLE SCREEN AND MAIN MENU - New rusty fence title screen. Press any key, A or Start to continue, same as before. - New main menu with full-screen comic key art, a bold DEMO tag under the logo, and big picture buttons for Continue

Your headlamp and night vision now work in multiplayer, extracting pays the flower bonuses, Rasp's Simple Stalking can be finished with friends, guns now eject spent casings, the full-size Mosins have new models, and other players' movement and attack animations finally match what they are doing. events.title: Zone Stalkers Demo 1.1.0 Hotfix: Raid Gear Stakes, Consumables, and Looting
events.summary: Stalkers, Demo 1.1.0 is a hotfix for Steam Next Fest. Raids in multiplayer now have real stakes again: if you die or bail before extracting, your uninsured gear and raid loot stay in the Zone. It also fixes Anti-Rad Pills and Take All in multiplayer, calms down the Trifecta bunker gunner, and lets you double-click to use food, drinks and meds. Multiplayer is still Experimental. events.summary: Stalkers, Demo 1.0.9 is live for Steam Next Fest. This one is all about raid and co-op fixes: you can join a raid already in progress again (now with a safe 5:00 window), the raid carries on properly if the host leaves, spectate teammates after you extract, artifacts and looted guns work in multiplayer, raid traders pay and sell properly, gear can be swapped mid-raid, and other players' footsteps now play where they happen. Multiplayer is still Experimental. MULTIPLAYER: JOINING A RAID IN PROGRE

events.title: The Zone Stalkers Free Demo Is Live on Steam
events.summary: Stalkers, the Zone Stalkers free demo is out now on Steam!Grab the demo and wishlist the full game here: The demo starts you in the Hub, the stalker base, then sends you out on a raid into the Kolkhoz. Choose your faction and play as Free Stalkers, Bratva Bandits or the Soldiers of Trifecta. You can play solo or squad up with friends in multiplayer co-op. Co-op is labeled (Experimental) because we're still actively working on it, so expect some rough edges.A quick heads-up: this is a demo build
